headings.usage: Main headlines, section titles. Use tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Paragraphs, UI elements, form labels. Use relaxed line-height.

primary.description: Deep Rose - Main CTA, Active States

secondary.description: Soft Blush Pink - Secondary buttons, highlights

foreground.description: Dark Warm Gray - Text (Corrected for contrast)

texture.usage: Overlay on background with opacity-20 mix-blend-multiply to create paper feel.

landing_page.description: Asymmetric layout. Hero section uses large romantic imagery with overlapping text. 'How it Works' uses a zig-zag layout.
landing_page.spacing: Generous. Section padding py-24 or py-32.

form_wizard.description: Centered container (max-w-xl). Clean white card on cream background. Progress bar at top. Smooth slide transitions between steps.
form_wizard.spacing: Compact internal spacing (p-8), large external margins.

results_page.description: 4 Cards. User's Original Idea (Col-span-2) vs 3 AI Alternatives. Bundle suggestion as a full-width banner.

buttons.style: Pill-shaped. Primary: Deep Rose with shadow-glow. Secondary: Blush Pink outline.

cards.style: Soft Card. White bg, 1px border-muted, shadow-card. Hover: border-primary/30 shadow-soft.

inputs.style: Minimalist. Bg-white, border-muted. Focus: border-primary ring-2 ring-primary/20.

progress_bar.style: Height 4px. Bg-muted. Indicator: Bg-primary with glowing end.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px. Color: Primary or Foreground.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text #4A4244 on #FEFDFD meets WCAG AA.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible ring-2 ring-primary/50 on all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install fonts (Manrope, Playfair Display) in index.css.
2. THEME: Update tailwind.config.js with the specific color palette provided. Do not use default shadcn colors.
3. GLOBAL CSS: Add the paper texture overlay to the body in index.css using ::before pseudo-element.
4. COMPONENTS: Customize shadcn components (Button, Input, Card) to match the 'Pill' and 'Soft Card' styles defined.
5. LAYOUT: Build the Landing Page using the 'Tetris Grid' principles. Do not just stack sections vertically.
6. FORM: Implement the 3-step wizard using 'framer-motion' for smooth transitions between steps.
7. RESULTS: Use the Bento Grid layout for the results. Highlight the 'Winner' (best option) visually.
8. TESTING: Add data-testid to all inputs and buttons.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic (generic centered layouts, gradients).
Create depth through layered design elements (z-index).
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
DO NOT center align the app container.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures and noise overlays are mandatory.
